top_signals.title: Goldman's Rosner: Fed Hikes ‘Metered,’ Not Big Cycle
top_signals.summary: Lindsay Rosner, head of multi-sector fixed income investing at Goldman Sachs Asset Management, expects a measured path for Fed hikes rather than a large tightening cycle. She also discusses stress in lower-quality credit, fixed income’s return as a portfolio ballast and opportunities in AI chip financing on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Hg’s Visma Plans Up to €6.5 Billion Debt Sale With UK IPO on Ice
top_signals.summary: Hg-owned Visma AS is working to sell as much as €6.5 billion ($7.1 billion) of debt to refinance loans and pay a dividend to shareholders, people familiar with the matter said, after its private equity backer put plans for an IPO of the Norwegian software firm on ice.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: McDonald's Moves on Makeover; Dick's Sporting Goods Up on Earnings | Stock Movers
top_signals.summary:
On this episode of Stock Movers:

- Anthropic (ANT) shares are lower and briefly traded below their $83 initial public offering price in premarket trading, wiping out gains for investors who piled into the artificial intelligence lab’s record-setting debut. 
- McDonald's (MCD) shares are moving on news the company's betting big on a makeover to win back customers. The chain is tearing down kitchen walls, adding hand-breaded chicken and trendy drinks, plus testing AI to take drive-thru orders. However, the nearly $800-thousand price tag per restaurant has franchisees pushing back and convincing them of the overhaul is becoming a big challenge for the fast food giant.
- Dick's Sporting Goods (DKS) shares are climbing after the retailer’s third-quarter results easily topped Street expectations. Management also boosted its adjusted EPS forecast for the full year, as well as the low end of its Dick’s stores comparable sales target. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
